name: voyager-ai
description: Voyager AI - Complete Travel Itinerary Generator with AI-powered planning

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt || py -m pip install -r requirements.txt || echo 'Python not found. Please install Python 3.8+ and add to PATH'
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.setup:backend:manual: cd backend && python -m venv venv && .\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1 && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.clean: npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean:backend
scripts.clean:frontend: cd frontend && powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .next, dist, node_modules/.cache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run serve:static
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:frontend: cd frontend && npm test || echo Frontend tests not configured
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && python -m pytest || echo Backend tests not configured
scripts.open:app: npm run open:frontend && npm run open:backend

author: Voyager AI Team
